student_learning_goal: I can identify and compare Canadian money.

header.student_learning_goal_banner: I can identify and compare Canadian money.
header.character_watermark: Penny + Cassie in the top-right at a market. Small (~1.5in). References blueprint.recurring_characters.

parts.visual_layout: Four coins and four bills with name lines under each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone money name layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. Top row: 4 coins (nickel, quarter, loonie, toonie). Bottom row: 4 bills ($5, $10, $20, $50). Each with name line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P1_NAME at Part 1: keywords name the coins and bills naming task.

parts.answer_key: nickel, quarter, loonie, toonie, fiver, ten, twenty, fifty.

parts.student_instructions: For 3 amount pairs, write MORE, LESS, or EQUAL.
parts.visual_layout: Three pair boxes each with two amounts and an answer line.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone compare layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 3 pairs: dime vs nickel, $5 vs $10, 1 toonie vs 2 loonies. Each with answer line.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P2_COMP at Part 2: keywords name the pairs compare answer task.

parts.student_instructions: Item costs $1. Item costs $5. Circle the right money for each.
parts.visual_layout: Two item icons with money options to circle for each.

image_placeholders.description: A Grade 1 capstone pay layout for money worksheet, B&W line art. 2 items: apple ($1) and book ($5). Below each: 4 money options to circle.
image_placeholders.text_image_alignment_check: WS05_P3_PAY at Part 3: keywords name the items money pay task.

early_finisher_prompt: If you finish, draw a market item with a price.
teacher_notes: Lesson 5 capstone. Summative artifact — score on rubric. Worksheet Parts 1-3 cover penny, nickel, quarter, loonie, toonie in price-tag tasks; success criteria reference dime and 50¢ which appear in Station 4 of the lesson. Document Station-to-Part mapping: Stations 1-3 → Worksheet Parts 1-3; Station 4 (dime + 50¢) is hands-on only — flag in teacher_notes.
